text:
Mikhail Sergachev has played more than 24 minutes a night, picked up 20 points in 18 games, and had an eight-game point streak into early November. Eleven of those points came on the power play, where he is Utah's quarterback, and at five on five the Mammoth take 57% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him out there.

One piece will come back to earth. He has 5 goals on 2.5 expected, shooting 12% after 6% last season. The chances are real; that finishing rate isn't. His ice time is the thing that won't fade: 25.3 minutes a game over the last ten, up 2.7.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking liked both ends last season: 6.5 primary shot assists per 60 (94th percentile among defensemen) and a 17% rate of stopping entries at his blue line, against a typical 11%. Our range has him finishing around 74 points, which would be a career year for a two-time Cup winner from Tampa. The goals slow down. The rest looks like the real thing.
headline: Sergachev is running Utah's blue line
